decisions.rationale: Initial exploration targeting diverse values across major sites s1, s3, and s5 to establish baseline effects relative to the default.
Test combinations of s1=A (which showed lowest f1) and s3=C (low f2) to balance costs, exploring s2 and s5 variations.
s1=D and s1=E achieve strong f2. Combining s1=D/E with components from s1=A (s3=A, s2=A) may balance f1 and f2, exploring non-dominated trade-offs.
s2=B dramatically lowers f2, especially with s1=D and s1=E. Combining s1=D or E with s2=B and s3=A (which yields low f1) should explore high-quality compromises on the Pareto front.
s2=B with s4=A yields low f2, while s1=D/A and s3=A minimize f1. Testing s1=A/B with s2=B and s4=A targets intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Testing s2=B combined with s4=A and s3=B/E to discover low f2 values while varying s1 across promising candidates (A, B, E) to probe unseen combinations.
Test s2=B combined with s4=A and s3=D on unexplored or promising s1/s5 choices to push f2 lower, and test s1=D/B with s3=B/E and s2=A to explore intermediate trade-offs.
Investigate s1=B with s2=B and s3=B/E which offer low f2 while maintaining relatively low f1. Also test s4=A on low f1 configurations (s3=A) with s2=A to explore intermediate trade-offs.
Testing s1=C with s3=D/B/C and s4=A to observe f2 and trade-offs, since s1=C ignores s2 and might offer lower costs between extreme Pareto modes.
Explores s1=C with s3=E to potentially improve f1 at low f2 (around 2880), tests s1=C with s3=A,s4=B for low f1, and tests s1=A with s3=B/E at s2=A.
Explore varied labels across all sites starting from orthogonal alternatives to map sensitivity relative to the baseline.
Config 3 achieved very low f1 with s3=C and s5=B. Pairing low-f1 features (s1=B, s3=C) with low-f2 parameters (s3=B, s5=D) explores trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Evaluating combinations targeting the extreme low f1 (s1=B, s2=A, s5=B, s4=B) with alternative s3 values, and exploring whether low f2 (s2=B) can achieve lower f1 with s1=B or C.
s1=E and s1=D achieve low f2 (~2600-2900). Testing s1=E, s2=B, s4=A with s3=B/D/E and s5 variations to optimize f2 and f1 simultaneously around the low-f2 Pareto boundary.
s2=B controls low f2, while s2=A controls low f1. Combining s1=D/E with s3/s4 variations under s2=B tests lower f2, while s1=C with s2=A and s4=B can improve the balanced knee.
Testing s1=C, s2=A with s3=A, s4=B to find lower f1 and f2 along the left frontier; also testing s1=D/E with s3=A/D, s4=B to explore trade-offs near minimal f2.
Combine low f1 from s1=C, s2=A, s4=B with varied s3 and s5 to push the f1-f2 boundary, and explore s1=A/s1=C with s2=B for lower f2.
s1=C, s2=A with s4=B achieves the lowest f1 values, while s1=D/E with s2=B yields low f2. We test unexplored combinations around s3=C/E/B with different s5 values.
Testing s1=D with s3=B,D,A and s4=A,s5=B achieved low f2. Exploring s1=C with s2=A and s4=B with varied s5, and s1=D/E with potential low f2 combinations.
s1=C, s2=A, s4=B, s5=C yields lowest f1, with s3=C or s3=E. Evaluating s5=E explores potential further f1/f2 reductions, and checking D/E with s3=B/A, s5=C tests low f2 bounds.
Initial exploration across major sites s1, s3, and s5 to identify sensitivity and baseline effects relative to the default evaluated point.
s2=B and s4=B strongly favor low f2, while s2=A and s4=A reduce f1. Testing s1=B with s2=B/s4=B explores whether s1=B can lower f1 without inflating f2.
s2=A drives very low f1 with high f2, while s4 and other factors trade off between them. Test s1=B, s2=A combinations with varying s4/s5 to bridge the Pareto gap and lower both objectives.
s2=A strongly reduces f1 while s2=B optimizes f2. We explore s1=D with s4=A and s5=B/C to see if we can improve upon f2 while maintaining low f1, as well as testing s1=C with s2=A.
Evaluating s2=B combined with s4=A or s5 variations to bridge intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs, and probing s1=D with s3=E/C to minimize f2 below 2624.
Explores combinations around the best f1 region (s1=B/A, s4=A) and searches for lower f2 near the original baseline (s2=B, s4=B) by testing s5 variations.
Testing s1=E with low f1 settings (s3=C/B, s4=A) and examining s3=B with s2=B variants to push the frontier below f2=2800 or achieve lower f1 at low f2.
Combining s1=B, s2=A, s3=C, s4=A which yields minimal f1 with varying s5, while also testing s1=E with s3=B,D and s5=A/C to optimize low f2 frontier.
s1=B, s2=A, s4=A yields the best f1 values, with s5=D yielding the minimum f1 so far. Testing alternative s3 choices (D, A, E) alongside s5=D to push the low-f1 Pareto front.
Evaluating s5=D with low-f1 and balanced s1/s3 settings, as s5=D sharply reduces f2 (e.g. config 45) while s2=B keeps f2 low and s1=E/B balances f1.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values for s1, s3, and s5 to identify main effects on f1 and f2 away from the baseline.
s1=A strongly minimizes f1 while s4=A and s3=B/C favor low f2. Exploring combinations mixing s1=A with low-f2 features to find intermediate Pareto points.
s2=B strongly reduces f2 while s1=A and s3=A reduce f1. Testing s1=A with s2=B and s3=A or other s5 variants could discover optimal trade-offs.
s2=A drives very low f1 while s2=B reduces f2. Pairing s1=A, s2=A with s3=A and s4=A or testing s3=E/D can balance or beat f1=4006 without excessive f2 penalty.
s1=A, s2=A, s4=B yielded the lowest f1 (4006) in config 2. Testing variations with other sites (s5=E, s3=E/C/B) to find lower f2 while preserving minimal f1.
s1=A, s2=A, s4=B yields very low f1 (~3.9k). Combining with s5=E, and testing s3 variants (C, D) or other s5 options may push f1 lower or improve f2.
Test s3=E with s2=A,s4=B,s5=E to seek Pareto improvements in low-f1 region, and explore s3=B with s1=B,s4=A,s5=C or original-like sites with s1=B for lower f2.
s3=E with s5=E yielded the lowest f2 (2304) and s1=A with s4=B yielded very low f1 (~3900). Testing s1/s2/s4/s5 variations around s3=E and s5=E.
Evaluating s1=C and s1=E with s2=B, s3=E, s5=E to test for lower f2 or better trade-offs than s1=D/B, alongside exploring s1=C/D with low-f1 configurations.
Testing s1=E and s1=D with s3=B, s4=B, s5=E to bridge low f1 and lower f2, and trying s1=D with s3=E to explore minimal f2.
Explore diverse orthogonal settings across all sites to quickly map main factor effects against the baseline evaluation.
s1=B and s2=A yielded the lowest f1 (config 3), while s4=B with s5=D/E significantly reduces f2. Combining low-f1 labels with low-f2 components explores balanced Pareto trade-offs.
s2=B strongly reduces f2 while s2=A lowers f1. s4=A lowered f1 in config 3. Testing combinations of s2=B with s4=A and variations in s1/s5 to improve the middle trade-off.
s4=B drives low f2, while s2=A lowers f1 dramatically. Testing combinations of s1=B, s4=B with s5=B/E and varying s3 to optimize the f2 vs f1 frontier.
s1=A/B with s2=B, s4=B, s5=B yielded minimal f2 (2304), while s2=A, s4=A yields minimal f1 (~3708). Testing s3=E with s1=A, s2=B, s5=B to push f2 further.
Test s1=B,A with s2=A, s4=A and varied s3/s5 to push minimal f1, alongside s2=B, s4=B configurations targeting minimal f2.
Testing s5=C on low-f2 architectures (s4=B, s2=B) and exploring potential minimum f1 candidates with s3=D/B, s4=A, and alternative s5 settings.
s1={A,B}, s2=B, s4=B, s5=B achieves the lowest f2, while s2=A, s4=A minimizes f1. Exploring untested s1 or intermediate interactions with s5=D may bridge or push the Pareto boundary.
Testing s1=C with s3=D/E, and s1=B, s2=A with unexplored combinations to find intermediate Pareto points between low f1 and low f2.
Evaluating s1=D with s4=B shows potential improvements in f2, while testing s1=C configurations may uncover better trade-offs in mid-f1/f2 ranges.
